prompt: Paint ONE object alone for 3D reconstruction: shown whole, in a three-quarter front view from slightly above, centred with a clear margin all round, on a plain flat light-grey background, soft even light, no cast shadow, no floor, no text, letters or logos anywhere, nothing else in the picture.
